make_checkpointer_default: create an async checkpointer that defaults to InMemorySaver when no config is provided
make_checkpointer_with_config: create an async checkpointer from an AppConfig with legacy or unified database settings
make_checkpointer_sqlite: create an async sqlite checkpointer that auto-creates parent directories and runs setup
make_checkpointer_postgres: create an async postgres checkpointer from a connection string in the app config
make_checkpointer_lifespan: use make_checkpointer as an async context manager for FastAPI lifespan resource cleanup
